method: Bend Time is Corvo's power only. The coverage harness grants it by name (lab-only grant), and the source casts it (LT at 2.6 s) and ends it (LT again at 6.2 s) with the product controller in the Dunwall tower safe room. The source reads the native start and release scene clocks and sends power variants 12 and 14, which the partner presents with the authored left-hand cast and its recovery (visual sweep 1260 accepted the standing and crouched casts; v42 crouched shoulders, v44 airborne). The case passes when the partner presentation stays live, the power is presented at full weight and the partner recovers to locomotion afterwards. The world time effect itself is gameplay, not body motion; the out-of-mana response belongs to power_interruptions_and_no_mana.

items.scope: Corvo's Bend Time cast and its end on the partner body, on the native scene clocks, recovering to locomotion.

visual.verdict: Corvo raises his left hand palm-out for the cast, holds it for about half a second and lowers it with the sword still in his right hand; the second press ends the power with the same gesture, and he settles back into his standing idle each time.
